subject: The slider you left at 48%
preview_text: Something changed since you last opened Volume Booster Pro. See what's new.
body_paragraphs: You opened the app once, slid the volume, and closed it. That was 48 days ago. Since then, the app changed. Maybe you didn't notice—but the boost engine got quieter, the UI got cleaner, and the EQ preset you never tried now remembers your headphones.

Power users who hated the ads in the free version told us: just give us the slider and nothing else. So we stripped everything that didn't belong. No pop-ups. No notifications. Just the boost, the EQ, and your audio. It sits in your status bar, applies when you plug in, and gets out of your way.

The feature you missed: auto-apply on headphone connect. Works system-wide—Spotify, YouTube, podcasts, games. Set it once, forget it. It's like having a calm assistant who only speaks when you need louder.
Open the app. See if the slider remembers where you left it. P.S. The EQ preset 'Deep Bass' pairs with your headphones—test it on a song you love.
